description:
Hushfacebook v0.1.4 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

This release adds Hide Reels in the feed, which takes the rows of reels between posts out of the news feed, along with the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends. A reel a friend posts stays.

19 patches in all. Sponsored and suggested posts leave the news feed without a gap, and ads are gone from Stories and Reels. Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and sending ad telemetry. Links open in your own browser, stories, reels and videos can be saved, and there's an AMOLED black theme or a Material You one if you want it.

Validation: 374 runtime tests passed locally. All 108 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 19 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 with no manifest changes.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
